title: Level events (eval/levels.json)
description: The moments a level was gained or the goal was reached, recorded from the scored runs by scripts/build_dashboard.py. Events are only ever added.

extension.description: Extension field: any key starting x_ holds data the engine never reads. Kept as is.

outcome.description: goal_reached only: how the goal ended, for example reached.

evidence.description: Ids of the evidence items and plan actions finished with evidence in the period that led to it.
